direct_pddl_instructions: This is an untyped STRIPS domain. Declare every problem object as an untyped name in :objects; never emit '- truck', '- airplane', '- location', '- city', '- airport', '- obj', or any other typed-object syntax.
Entity categories are ordinary INIT predicates, not PDDL types. Preserve every explicit OBJ, TRUCK, LOCATION, AIRPLANE, CITY, and AIRPORT fact.
Use (in-city LOCATION CITY) for location-to-city membership, (in CARGO VEHICLE) for loaded cargo, and (at ENTITY LOCATION) for position. Preserve these argument roles exactly.
